subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers split and retire this broad field-report issue now, keep it open as the umbrella tracker, or close it as superseded by the narrower active trackers?
rationale: The issue spans config recovery, Discord/channel delivery, cron ergonomics, web search, setup auth, resource policy, and update process behavior; current main proves partial fixes but not a single complete implementation path.

options.title: Split and retire umbrella
options.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep the active config and catch-up trackers as durable work, then close this issue after links are complete.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Leave this issue open as a broad field-report tracker until every historical slice is fixed, rejected, or separately tracked.

options.title: Close as superseded now
options.body: Close this issue with links to active canonical issues and ask for fresh focused reports if the weaker slices recur.

recommendation.title: Split and retire umbrella
recommendation.body: Move unresolved slices to canonical owner-scoped issues, keep the active config and catch-up trackers as durable work, then close this issue after links are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-surface product routing and issue hygiene decision rather than a single code-owner fix, and their recent history is closest to config docs, channel policy, and maintainer triage.
